inputModel: The session pins, steward, registry writer and finality-proof pins are verifier-owned. railRegistryIndex uses CORE's RegistryIndexSnapshot and RegistryIndexEntry shape as a projection of the DACS-4 numeric snapshot; its revision is the session's railRegistryVersion. The definition receipt is matched by nativeAddress to the selected entry's anchor locator. Receipt blockRef.timestamp is CORE SR2-6 consensus time in unix ms.
